deliverable: Intended users; one recurring job; input/output; claim boundaries; case and evidence cutoffs; accountable review role
acceptance_evidence: A reader can distinguish record transcription, evidence assessment and clinical interpretation; provisional commercial/partner assumptions explicit
boundary: Do not turn an unconfirmed clinical role into a supplied partner

owner_role_not_assigned_person: Product lead with clinician and patient participants
deliverable: Workflow map; source access barriers; current brief; cold-start and update work; patient goals
acceptance_evidence: Useful output and follow-up owner identified; acquisition plus review effort recorded
boundary: No outreach or patient-data access is authorized by this planning artifact

mission: Create the authored challenge cases and reference brief
owner_role_not_assigned_person: Clinical product lead plus independent reviewer
deliverable: Multiple fictional subjects; document sources; known date/identity/uncertainty conflicts; amendments; expected results
acceptance_evidence: Challenge cases include wrong-subject import, unknown-vs-negative, order-vs-administration, duplicate and delayed records
boundary: Synthetic test cases do not establish representative clinical performance

mission: Freeze the rights boundary for the slice
deliverable: Exact code/data/assets/model/service inventory; permitted use; source evidence; obligations; exclusion plan
acceptance_evidence: Every included external component has documented scope; unresolved items are omitted or held
boundary: A repository badge or green scan is not whole-product clearance

mission: Choose the smallest persistence and interoperability boundary
deliverable: Bounded comparison of application-owned domain/FHIR adapters and Medplum against imports/amendments/export/isolation
acceptance_evidence: Decision records operational burden, versioning, extension effort, rights and exit path; no mandated framework
boundary: HAPI enters comparison only if an actual interoperability requirement justifies it

mission: Persist immutable sources and typed assertions
deliverable: Source version/receipt; subject linkage; original and normalized value; context; event/report/receipt dates; source anchors
acceptance_evidence: Imported bytes survive restart; every displayed consequential assertion resolves to source version; wrong-subject input quarantined
boundary: Begin with independently authored text reports under a declared import contract; manual extraction is a baseline; prefilled fixtures do not prove import

mission: Add scoped review and persistent questions
deliverable: Source-side-by-side review; correction/disagreement; question owner/status; investigation snapshot
acceptance_evidence: Extraction review cannot be mistaken for clinical endorsement; questions and statuses persist
boundary: Reading modes remain distinct from real account authorization

owner_role_not_assigned_person: Evidence workflow owner plus clinical reviewer
deliverable: One focused question; permitted evidence; claim support; applicability limits; uncertainty; dated brief
acceptance_evidence: Claim support can be inspected; metadata-only discovery is labelled; no inferred treatment efficacy or eligibility
boundary: Use a lawful frozen evidence item if live integration is not yet qualified

deliverable: Amended/out-of-order/duplicate source import; dependent-output invalidation; reviewable changes
acceptance_evidence: Receipt flags affected snapshots stale; replacement stays draft until scoped review; exports show status; history recoverable; duplicates create no event; unrelated subject unaffected
boundary: Different specimen or assay does not automatically supersede an earlier result

mission: Demonstrate the first end-to-end investigation workflow
deliverable: Local synthetic-data demonstration; repeatable scenario; actual test results; limitations; source manifest; current release status
acceptance_evidence: Full sequence runs from imported source bytes to reviewable update and export; unsupported functions are explicit
boundary: Not a clinical release, evidence of demand, or a complete oncology platform

deliverable: Baseline comparison; task contract; permitted provider/model; source-grounded proposals; abstention
acceptance_evidence: Consequential error taxonomy and correction burden measured on held-out cases; model identity/inputs recorded
boundary: Do not select by model reputation or agent count; clinical thresholds require agreed protocol

mission: Define intended use and real-data governance
owner_role_not_assigned_person: Clinical product, privacy/security and regulatory reviewers
deliverable: Function-level intended-use assessment; data roles; access basis; agreements as needed; retention; provider/egress policy
acceptance_evidence: Actual access and review responsibilities established; consumer/provider pathways distinguished
boundary: Research label, encryption, or clinician toggle alone does not settle obligations

deliverable: Identity/delegation; files/search/jobs/export access; sensitive logging controls; backup/restore; incident handling
acceptance_evidence: Cross-case and revoked-access tests pass for supported flows; restored data and source versions verified

owner_role_not_assigned_person: Evaluation lead with independent oncology adjudication
deliverable: Representative permitted inputs; reference/adjudication protocol; current-workflow and simpler-system comparators
acceptance_evidence: Meaningful burden reduction assessed against prespecified consequential-error limits; omissions/contradictions and cutoff leakage reported; error-rate improvement is a separate outcome
boundary: No automatic conclusion that synthetic performance transfers

deliverable: Scoped protocol; safety/incident ownership; patient comprehension; cost per reviewed initial case/update; repeat usage
acceptance_evidence: Observed benefit and responsible buyer/support model justify continued scope; stop/pivot criteria applied
boundary: No promised dates, treatment outcomes, procurement success or patient benefit

deliverable: Registered/reviewable/analyzable/research-linked adapter; specimen context; QC; code/model/reference versions
acceptance_evidence: Specific scientific/clinical question, lawful data and independent task evaluation justify integration
boundary: Raw-image/genome research outputs do not become clinical facts automatically

mission: Qualify trial evidence and screening functions
owner_role_not_assigned_person: Clinical research coordinator and evidence owner
deliverable: Protocol/version references; criterion-level support/unknowns; current site information; reviewer workflow
acceptance_evidence: Candidate screening remains distinct from confirmed eligibility; rights and function-specific evaluation pass
boundary: A registry entry does not confirm recruitment availability or enrollment

mission: Maintain source/model freshness and retire affected outputs
